card.name: Verbs saying studies were lacking
card.fires_on: The verb or adjective after a study or data subject that says evidence is missing, such as 'did not include', 'inadequate' or 'are needed'. Seen in geriatric-use and research-gap sentences.

modes.label: Studies did not include
modes.description: Verb after 'clinical studies ... did not' in geriatric use statements, before 'sufficient numbers of subjects'.
modes.example: Clinical studies of Phenelzine Sulfate Tablets did not<< include>> sufficient numbers of subjects aged 65

modes.label: Data inadequate or needed
modes.description: Adjective or verb saying data are lacking or more studies are called for.
